quotes.text: Insider threats are hard to detect because they come from authorized users. They're not breaking in. They're logging in. And logging in looks exactly like normal work.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up in a few words why perimeter security misses insider risk.

quotes.text: Traditional security tools keep bad actors out, but they're not designed to spot a trusted employee who suddenly starts acting differently.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the exact gap that behavior-based insider risk detection fills.

quotes.text: The system doesn't flag a single action. It flags patterns over time. One large download might be completely innocent.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the core pattern-based scoring principle behind the tool.

quotes.text: You can view the evidence without revealing everything to the user. The investigator sees the activity, but the system doesn't expose the content of emails or documents unless you explicitly choose to reveal it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows how privacy by design works in practice during an investigation.

quotes.text: This isn't about distrusting your employees. It's about protecting the company and the data everyone depends on.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames insider risk monitoring as protection rather than surveillance.

chapters.title: Why traditional security misses insider threats
How risk is defined and scored

takeaways: Insider threats come from authorized users, so perimeter tools like firewalls and MFA cannot detect them on their own.
Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management scores patterns of behavior over time using templates, indicators and optional HR or physical security signals.
Start small with one or two templates and a pilot group, tune thresholds for about 30 days and train investigators on privacy controls like anonymized user names.
hook: Your biggest data risk may already be logged in: departing employees, careless sharing and unapproved apps all look like normal work to traditional security. This episode explains for compliance and IT teams how Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management detects risky patterns, supports privacy-preserving investigations and can be rolled out step by step.
